'''Datar''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ghostling]] species. Its [[Arawynne|princess]] was kidnapped by [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], though [[Gender/Legends|she]] and several other Ghostling children were rescued by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].

Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was home to a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Unidentified Rebel Alliance base (Datar)|base]]. In the [[Attack at Datar]], the Rebels fought the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] forces to the last man, but were defeated by [[Vice Admiral/Legends|Vice Admiral]] [[Slenn]]'s forces. Slenn himself was either [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the battle, or executed for incompetence by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] afterward.
